title: Global Express XRS — ultra-long-range reel
hook: Range that turns a continent into a commute.
body:
The Global Express XRS was built for the missions most jets can't finish in one leg. This 2005 airframe carries the coverage buyers actually care about: engines enrolled on Rolls-Royce Corporate Care, APU on MSP Gold — the programs that protect the number when it's time to sell.

Ultra-long-range, large cabin, and a maintenance story you can defend. That's a position, not just an airplane.

Full spec and status reports available on request.
